notes: The served counts match PMID 36942789. The abstract states: Data from 795 patients were analyzed. The arm denominators therefore describe the analysed population; 800 patients underwent randomization, but randomized arm totals and an explicit intention-to-treat designation are NOT_IN_PACKET. Mortality was assessed at 28 days, not the row metadata window of 14 days or its 30-day or in-hospital timepoint; 14 days appears as a treatment-duration option. The other held abstract, PMID 32876689, shares NCT02517489 but describes a COVID-19 cohort with hydrocortisone and placebo arms, 11 and 20 deaths, and a day-21 composite primary outcome; those observations do not correspond to the served row and are not merged here.
